definitions.explanation: Relating to or occurring on the surface of the sea, often used in compound words relating to maritime activities.

examples.japanese: {海上|かいじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
{海上|かいじょう}{保安庁|ほあんちょう}。
{海上|かいじょう}⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

notes:
{海上|かいじょう} means 'on the sea' or 'maritime', often used in compound words.

COMPOUNDS:
- {海上|かいじょう}{保安庁|ほあんちょう}: Japan Coast Guard
- {海上|かいじょう}⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧: maritime transport
- {海上|かいじょう}{自衛隊|じえいたい}: Maritime Self-Defense Force
- {海上|かいじょう}⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧: maritime traffic
- {海上|かいじょう}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: marine insurance

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧: sea, ocean
- ⟦{陸上|りくじょう}→陸上：09245_rikujou⟧: on land
- ⟦{航海|こうかい}→航海：02797_koukai⟧: voyage, navigation

NOTE: Do not confuse with ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧ (venue), which has the same reading.
